pr_title: [Performance][Ops] Support stride-aware recurrent KDA state updates

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha f91ea5a 体现修改

rule.description: 当 kernel 通过原地更新消费状态张量时，不应在每次调用时分配不会被使用的输出状态张量，应通过标志位控制避免 materializing 多余张量。
checkpoints: 识别 kernel 中是否存在 `at::empty_like` 分配但结果从未被读取的张量
检查 `output_final_state` / `inplace_final_state` 等标志位是否正确设置以避免不必要分配
确认 decode 热路径上没有重复的 tensor allocation 开销

antipattern.context: When `output_final_state` is `false` (which is the default for vLLM as it consumes the state through in-place cache updates), allocating a new `final_state` tensor via `at::empty_like(initial_state)`

pattern.context: When `output_final_state` is `false` (which is the default for vLLM as it consumes the state through in-place cache updates), allocating a new `final_state` tensor via `at::empty_like(initial_state)`

diff.unified:
--- a/csrc/attention/recurrent_kda/recurrent_kda_torch_adpt.h
+++ b/csrc/attention/recurrent_kda/recurrent_kda_torch_adpt.h
@@ -1,13 +1,13 @@
 // csrc/attention/recurrent_kda/recurrent_kda_torch_adpt.h
-// 位于 recurrent KDA state update 函数内，约第 110-125 行
     // --- prepare state tensors ---
     at::Tensor initial_state = ...;  // recurrent state from KDA cache
     const char* layout = is_tnd ? "TND" : "BSND";
 
-    // ❌ output_final_state=true 导致每次 decode 都分配 final_state 张量
-    // 但 vLLM 只通过 in-place 更新 initial_state 消费结果，final_state 从未被读取
-    bool output_final_state = true;
-    at::Tensor final_state = at::empty_like(initial_state);  // ❌ 每个 decode step 都分配，显著开销
+    // ✅ vLLM consumes the cache mutation through initial_state and returns only
+    // ✅ the attention output. Avoid materializing a second full state tensor.
+    bool output_final_state = false;   // ✅ 不输出 final_state，避免分配
+    bool inplace_final_state = true;   // ✅ kernel 直接原地更新 initial_state
+    at::Tensor final_state = initial_state;  // ✅ 复用 initial_state，不分配新内存
 
     bool state_v_first = true;
     EXEC_NPU_CMD(
@@ -16,8 +16,10 @@
         initial_state,
         final_state,
         output_final_state,
+        inplace_final_state,       // ✅ 新增参数：原地更新标志
         use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel,
         ...
         state_v_first,
-        output);
-    // final_state 分配后从未被使用，纯粹浪费内存带宽
+        output,
+        final_state);
+    // ✅ 每个 decode step 节省一次完整 state tensor 的分配开销
key_changes: 移除: // 位于 recurrent KDA state update 函数内，约第 110-125 行
新增: // ✅ the attention output. Avoid materializing a second full state tensor.
